title: A Variational Eigenvalue Solver on a Photonic Quantum Processor
authors: Alberto Peruzzo, Jarrod McClean, Peter Shadbolt et al.
abstract: We report the experimental simulation of molecular ground-state energies using a hybrid quantum-classical variational approach on a photonic quantum chip.
fullExcerpt: Quantum chemistry calculations require computing ground-state energies of molecular Hamiltonians. The Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE) optimizes parameterized rotation angles theta using classical gradient descent while measuring expectation values <H> on a quantum processor.

precomputedClaims.claim: VQE executes shallow parameterized circuits resilient to NISQ decoherence.
precomputedClaims.sourceQuote: A hybrid quantum-classical variational algorithm enables ground-state calculations on existing hardware.
precomputedClaims.notes: Avoids deep circuits required by traditional Quantum Phase Estimation (QPE).

openGaps: Barren plateaus in parameter optimization landscapes for large molecular systems.
